state.question: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?
state.summary: The transition from the beginning of the story in Video 1 to the ending in Video 2 involves a sequence of events that are not fully visible.

candidate_observations.observable: What specific events occurred between the beginning of the story in Video 1 and the ending in Video 2?
candidate_observations.purpose: To determine the missing interval of the story.

events.description: Two children walk on a boardwalk, then three children on bikes approach them.
A glowing man appears beside a girl with a bike. He interacts with her and the environment.
The children are on bikes near food stalls and rides, with a boy looking at a large structure.
Boy on bicycle looks at large structure under scaffolding.
Children with bikes stand near food stalls. Car with 'Wonder Wharf' visible.
Children look at amusement park entrance. Naval officer appears in mirror room.
Wide view of park. Children and adults walk. A man pushes a cart.
A woman runs past. A man runs after her. A cart is visible.
Naval officer exits vehicle. Park ride and sign visible.
Three children observe a large rock structure with a roller coaster track from a wooden pier.
Children are inside a ride vehicle, looking forward with neutral expressions.
Adults and children wave from inside a ride vehicle, looking out at a bright sky.
A large rock structure with a roller coaster track and a door is shown.
Children on bicycles approach a blue vehicle near a roller coaster track.
Three children stand in ornate hall. One child looks surprised. Camera zooms out to reveal more of the grand interior.
Children follow a one-eyed doctor through a grand hall. He gestures toward a stage with a submarine exhibit. He pulls a lever, revealing a sea scene.
Group enters a lavish, nautical-themed theater. An old man in a white suit gestures toward a statue of Neptune.
Group explores a cluttered, dimly lit underground garage filled with novelty cars and arcade machines.
Group hides in floor hole in pink-themed ice cream parlor. Staff member visible behind counter.
Group remains hidden in floor hole. Scene shifts to dim warehouse with shelves and toys.
Group emerges from floor hole in dilapidated room with overturned chairs and covered furniture.
Group walks through ornate, nautical-themed hall. Characters interact with statue and each other.
Group stands in hall with statue. One-eyed doctor and naval officer visible.
A man in a white coat stands with two children. A man in a naval uniform walks toward a bar where another man in pink stands.
The man in pink and the naval officer stand near the bar. The children remain in the foreground.
The man in pink faces the children. The pink-eared girl gestures toward him. The naval officer is visible in the background.
